normative_provenance.candidate_terminology_policy: S-C01 candidate terminology is not included and is not normative for this source-stage task.

query_field_scope.value: The source's q default searchable scope is not established.
query_field_scope.consequence: No final claim may say that cross-concept matches occur in one field, title/abstract only, or all metadata fields until a successful response and field contrasts are recorded.

draft_q_notation.term_rendering: Every normative literal is double-quoted; no truncation, stemming notation, wildcard, descriptor, or candidate terminology was added.
draft_q_notation.important_limit: The API did not return a successful result during this pilot. These are exact UTF-8 draft cells, not accepted proof that current NTRS parses the notation or preserves the stated semantics.

diagnostic_publication_date.upper_bound_label: pilot execution-date diagnostic upper bound only; P-001 remains unresolved and this is not the final common cutoff

final_date_handling.value: Use exact ISO lower and P-001 upper dates only after transport validation and a separately scoped adapter fix.

language.reason: No successful API response validated language metadata or a language filter; screening, not this pilot, determines report language.

controlled_vocabulary.decision: No controlled-vocabulary or indexed-term supplement is accepted for this draft translation.
controlled_vocabulary.why_not_accepted: The static public client exposes these names, but no successful API response, field behavior, scope note, hierarchy, explosion setting, or suitable public known-record descriptor could be inspected. A generic systems-engineering heading alone would not satisfy MBSE in any event.
controlled_vocabulary.future_rule: If a genuine usable descriptor is established, retain every free-text block and add it only as an OR supplement inside its mapped block after a scope/hierarchy/known-record test.

paired_term_handling.normative_requirement: Pairs must be unordered within one searchable field with at most five intervening lexical tokens.
paired_term_handling.draft_transport: Each pair is rendered as a broad left-group + right-group conjunct inside one q request. It keeps every literal and cannot be treated as a validated same-field or <=5-token implementation.
paired_term_handling.acceptance_gate: Do not use BG1, BG2, BC1, or BT2 as an accepted final translation until a successful API test proves a native proximity form or proves that this broader fallback cannot lose exact same-field matches; otherwise tag exact pairs locally only where allowed by the final method.

query_length_and_cell_policy.current_cells: One prospective cell per semantic partition; no partition is silently narrowed or split.
query_length_and_cell_policy.future_split_rule: If a current NTRS parser or request limit is demonstrated, define cells prospectively before final execution, preserve every exact cell query and total, retrieve every cell completely, and reconcile the lossless stable-NTRS-id union without using a partial prefix.

lossless_union_rule.per_partition: The stable-ID union of all successfully complete cells mapped to a partition is that partition's result set. A one-cell partition has the identity set of its sole cell.
lossless_union_rule.identity: NTRS record id only after nonempty uniqueness and stability have been observed; no DOI substitution or deduplication is permitted to mask a missing/duplicate NTRS id.
lossless_union_rule.failure: A failed, null-total, short, stale, reordered, duplicate-ID, or incomplete cell invalidates that cell/event and imports no prefix.

partitions.normative_expression: P AND E_F AND (M_H OR M_B)
partitions.role: EPS functions or analyses × all model terms
